Name: JP Cheats Menu
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][b][i]﻿[color=#00ff00]﻿[u][center]JP Cheats Menu[/center][/u][/color][/i][/b][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because there are never enough tricks in this game, at least these can be more useful for speeding things up.[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[b][size=3]This wonderful menu provides more cheats for the game that can be useful in specific situations not covered by the CJB Cheats Menu.[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][u]PC:[/u][/size][/color][/b][b]
[/b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/tJQSxCkr/CMM2.gif[/img]
[b][size=4]To access it during gameplay, simply press the [color=#ffff00]key “J”[/color] (by default, but you can change it in GMCM to another key or combination of keys!).
You can navigate the menu using either the arrows on the right side of the menu or the mouse wheel.[/size][/b]
[b][color=#00ffff][size=5][u]
MOBILE:
[/u][/size][/color][/b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/C5TPqL76/CMM.gif[/img]
[b][size=4]To access it during gameplay, you must briefly [color=#ffff00]touch the screen with two fingers.[/color] (Both the time and the number of fingers can be configured through [color=#00ffff]GMCM[/color], it works!).
You can navigate the menu using the arrows on the right side of the menu or by sliding your finger up or down, inside or outside the menu!
[color=#ffff00]As an alternative method, you can use a virtual keyboard and use the configured key.[/color][/size][/b]



[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vmDXc6r0/daw-2-7-2026-67840365.png[/img]
[size=5][b][i][color=#00ffff]Now when you open the menu during an event, you can skip it immediately, regardless of whether this event could not originally be skipped. [/color][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.3)[/color][/i][/b][/size]


[size=5][b][i][color=#00ffff]Below is a simple summary of the menu and a description of its functions: [/color][color=#ffff00](There are important things at the bottom!)[/color][/i][/b][/size]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRGyCp5R/Test_1_10_2026_67344688.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]Refill Health & Energy No introduction needed, right?[/size]
[*][size=3]Give Me Gold Manually enter the amount of gold you want.[/size]
[*][size=3]Speed Buff, Buffs: Skills, Buffs: Status Manually enter the attribute improvement level; they last until you go to sleep.[/size]
[*][size=3]Skill Levels Manually enter the skill level.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0QCDJ9Bj/Test_1_10_2026_67354212.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]Max Daily Luck Well, that...[/size]
[*][size=3]Max Friendship (All) Maximum friendship with NPCs, even strangers. [/size]
[*][size=3]Date Me Turn a bachelor NPC into your lover.[/size]
[*][size=3]Marry Me Turn a bachelor NPC into your spouse, even if you don't know each other.[/size]
[*][size=3]Reset Relationship Removes any relationship or spouse status and resets friendship hearts with an NPC.[/size]
[*][size=3]Mark All Events Seen [b][color=#ff0000]I don't know how powerful it is, but it could be destructive. [/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Force Wedding (Event) Select an NPC from the list and the wedding event will be played the following day. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.1)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Forget All Event Seen (Reset) Mark all events you have already seen as Unseen, and you will be able to see the events again. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.1)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Unlock All Crafting/Cooking Recipes Unlock all recipes instantly with no level or friendship requirements. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.1)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Complete Collections (Perfection)... Mark all items as delivered to the Shipping Bin, useful for Perfection progress. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.1)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Unlock All Masteries Complete all masteries instantly and take you to the cave to claim your rewards.  [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.4)[/color][/b][/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/PxMY8dR5/Test_1_10_2026_67360252.png[/img]﻿[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Time Control (Speed) Freeze, slow down, or speed up time.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Unlock Community Center Open the CC door, allow the scrolls to be read, and all scrolls are unlocked.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Complete Community Center Repair the CC, get the rewards such as the bus and greenhouse, and immediately build the theater. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.3)[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Complete Joja Route Complete all of Joja's requests and instantly build the theater. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.3)[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Unlock All Doors Access any room without needing to be friends with the NPC.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Upgrade All Buildings (+1 Lvl) Upgrade any building, including Mods, to the next level. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.4)[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Upgrade All Buildings (Max) Upgrade any building, including Mods, to the maximum level. [b][color=#ffff00](Rework 1.0.4)[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Upgrade Farmhouse (Max) Upgrade the Farmhouse to the maximum level and move any items in the black zone at the time of upgrading to a chest.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nz1BQnPL/Test_1_10_2026_67369411.png[/img]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]﻿[/font][size=3]Warp To Map Lets you go to almost any available map; NoClip is required. [b][color=#00ff00](New 1.0.5)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Clear Location... Allows you to remove all objects from the current map, separated by category (debris, trees, crops, etc.).[/size]
[*][size=3]Set Farm Type... Allows you to swap your farm for another one, either from the game or from a mod. [/size]
[/list]
[/font][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/1tKwNyj0/Test_1_10_2026_67375134.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]Spawn Ghost Horse Makes a horse appear beside you, which disappears when you dismount.[/size]
[*][size=3]Max Farm Animals Friendship Maximum friendship with your animals. [/size]
[*][size=3]Spawn Animal (In Building) It allows you to create animals from the game or from Mods, corresponding to Coop or Barn, without having to go to Marnie.[/size]
[*][size=3]Farm Animal Age It allows you to make your animals adults or turn them into babies. [/size]
[*][size=3]Summon Farm Animal Here It allows you to teleport one of your animals to your location. [/size]
[*][size=3]Spawn Pet (Farm/Farmhouse) It allows you to create any pet in the game or mod without having to go to Marnie. [/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RhVf72k6/Test_1_10_2026_67391150.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]Summon Pet Here Teleport a pet to your location. [/size]
[*][size=3]Rename Pet... Allows you to rename your pet with a maximum of 20 characters (previously 11).[/size]
[*][size=3]Max Pet Friendship Maximum friendship with your pets. [/size]
[*][size=3]Reset Pet Cooldown You can pet your pets again![/size]
[*][size=3]Warp to NPC... It takes you directly to the selected NPC. [/size]
[*][size=3]Force NPC Event... You can view ANY NPC event without having to meet any prerequisites. [/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Y0qg6T5L/Test_1_10_2026_67396609.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]Toggle Free Mod (Build/Craft/Shop) Everything for free! [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.4)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Get All Special Items It gives you all the items from the wallet.[/size]
[*][size=3]Get Animal Catalogue It gives you the book that allows you to shop at Marnie's store when she's not there. [/size]
[*][size=3]Get all Reading Books It gives you all the books, even mods. [/size]
[*][size=3]Spawn Skill Books It gives you all the books that give XP.[/size]
[*][size=3]Spawn All Lost Books It gives you all the books you can read in the library. [/size]
[*][size=3]Upgrade All Tools Instantly upgrade (or downgrade) all tools.[/size]
[*][size=3]Get Missing Museum Items It gives you all the minerals/Artifacts that you haven't donated yet. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.1)[/color][/b][/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6q5RrFkc/Test_1_10_2026_67408067.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]Current Location Utils... Spawn of Critters and Junimos, transformation of the farm and trees, etc. [b][color=#ffff00](Updated 1.0.4)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Trigger Farm Event (Tonight) Nighttime events such as witches, meteorites, UFOs, etc. [/size]
[*][size=3]Open Shop Menu (All Shops)... Open any store in the game from anywhere, even Mods. [/size]
[*][size=3]Rush Local NPCs Makes NPCs in your location move faster and dodge everything (like when you stand in front of them). [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.3)[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Instant NPC Arrival Teleport all NPCs to their destinations. [b][color=#ffff00](New 1.0.3)[/color][/b][/size]
[/list][size=3]

[/size][color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]That's all for now. It has quite a few useful features (and others not so much, eh, “???” option). [u]In the future, it can continue to expand with suggestions from users.[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]


[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/size][/color][/i]
[/b]

[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
